nodes.summary: Let $q$ and $g$ be natural numbers with $g \mid q - 1$, let $K$ be a finite field with $q^2$ elements, and let $\theta \in K$ be a primitive $(q^2 - 1)$-th root of unity, that is, a generator of $K^\times$. If $a$ and $b$ are natural numbers less than $q^2 - 1$ with $(\theta^a - \theta)^q = \theta^a - \theta$ and $(\theta^b - \theta)^q = \theta^b - \theta$, and $(q^2 - 1)/g$ divides $a - b$, then $a = b$.
nodes.title: Nonzero differences of the Bose–Chowla set avoid the subgroup of order $g$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, let $\alpha_g(n)$ be the largest size of a set $A \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}$ such that every nonzero integer $x$ is the difference $a - a'$ of at most $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. If $g \ge 1$, then for every real $\varepsilon > 0$ we have $\alpha_g(n) \le (1 + \varepsilon)\sqrt{gn}$ for all sufficiently large $n$; that is, $\alpha_g(n) \le (1 + o(1))\sqrt{gn}$.
nodes.title: Upper bound for sets with bounded difference multiplicities

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, let $\alpha_g(n)$ be the largest size of a set $A \subseteq [n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ such that every nonzero integer $x$ is the difference $a - a'$ of at most $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. Then $\alpha_g(n) \le n$, since these sets are subsets of $[n]$.
nodes.title: Trivial upper bound for sets with bounded difference multiplicities

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, let $\alpha_g(n)$ be the largest size of a set $A \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}$ such that every nonzero integer $x$ is the difference $a - a'$ of at most $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. Then for every natural number $g$ we have $\alpha_g(1) = 1$: the singleton $\{1\}$ has no nonzero differences.
nodes.title: The value $\alpha_g(1) = 1$

nodes.summary: For a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ and $x \in \mathbb{Z}$, write $r_{A-A}(x)$ for the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$. For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, $\alpha_g(n)$ is the largest size of a set $A \subseteq [n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ with $r_{A-A}(x) \le g$ for every nonzero integer $x$.
nodes.title: Maximal sets with bounded difference multiplicities

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, let $\eta_g(n)$ be the least size of a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ such that every $x \in \{1, \dots, n\}$ is the difference $a - a'$ of at least $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. Then for all natural numbers $g$ and $n$,
nodes.title: Upper bound for the $g$-difference basis number

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $m$, let $\eta_g(m)$ be the least size of a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ such that every $x \in \{1, \dots, m\}$ is the difference $a - a'$ of at least $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. If $q$ is a prime and $n$ and $v$ are natural numbers with $n \le q^2 v$, then $\eta_g(n) \le (q + 1)\,\eta_g(v)$.
nodes.title: Scaling bound for the $g$-difference basis number

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, let $\eta_g(n)$ be the least size of a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ such that every $x \in \{1, \dots, n\}$ is the difference $a - a'$ of at least $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. If $n > 1$ and $g \ge 1$, then $\eta_1(n) \le \eta_g(n) \le g\,\eta_1(n)$.
nodes.title: Comparing $g$-difference bases with difference bases

nodes.summary: Let $\eta_1(1)$ be the least size of a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ containing elements $a, a'$ with $a - a' = 1$. Then $\eta_1(1) = 2$: such a set needs two elements, and $\{0, 1\}$ is one.
nodes.title: The value $\eta_1(1) = 2$

nodes.summary: For a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ and $x \in \mathbb{Z}$, write $r_{A-A}(x)$ for the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$. For natural numbers $g$ and $n$, a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ is a $g$-difference basis for $[n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ if $r_{A-A}(x) \ge g$ for every $x \in [n]$, and $\eta_g(n)$ is the least size of such a set.
nodes.title: The $g$-difference basis number

nodes.summary: For every integer $g \ge 1$ there are finite sets $A_n \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}$ of integers, one for each $n \in \mathbb{N}$, such that for every $n$ each nonzero integer $x$ equals $a - a'$ for at most $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A_n \times A_n$, and $|A_n| / \sqrt{gn} \to 1$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Lower-bound construction for sets with bounded difference multiplicities

nodes.summary: For every finite field $K$ with $q$ elements, the least size $\eta_1(K)$ of a set $A \subseteq K$ such that every element of $K$ is a difference $a - a'$ of two elements of $A$ satisfies $\eta_1(K) \le 100 \sqrt{q}$.
nodes.title: Square-root bound for difference bases of finite fields

nodes.summary: The least size $\eta_1(\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z})$ of a set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z}$ such that every element of $\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z}$ is a difference $a - a'$ of two elements of $A$ equals $2$: the set $\{0, 1\}$ has differences $0, 1, 2$, and one element is not enough.
nodes.title: Difference basis number of $\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: For an abelian group $G$ let $\eta_1(G)$ be the least size of a set $A \subseteq G$ such that every element of $G$ is a difference $a - a'$ of two elements of $A$. If $K$ is a finite field with $q$ elements whose characteristic is not $2$, then $\eta_1(K \times K) \le q + \eta_1(K)$, where $K$ and $K \times K$ are taken as additive groups.
nodes.title: Difference bases of the square of a finite field

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, the least size $\eta_1(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})$ of a set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ such that every residue modulo $p$ is a difference $a - a'$ of two elements of $A$ satisfies $\eta_1(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}) \le 2 \lceil \sqrt{p} \rceil$.
nodes.title: Difference bases of the integers modulo a prime

nodes.summary: For an abelian group $G$ and $g \in \mathbb{N}$, a $g$-difference basis of $G$ is a finite set $A \subseteq G$ such that every $x \in G$ equals $a - a'$ for at least $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. The difference basis number $\eta_g(G)$ is the least size of a $g$-difference basis of $G$, and $0$ if $G$ has none.
nodes.title: Difference basis number of an abelian group

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and $k = \lceil \sqrt{n} \rceil$. The set of integers $B_n = \{1, \dots, k - 1\} \cup \{k, 2k, \dots, k^2, (k + 1)k\}$ has $2k$ elements, and every $x \in \{1, \dots, n\}$ is a difference $b - b'$ of two elements of $B_n$.
nodes.title: Rédei–Rényi difference basis

nodes.summary: Let $g, q, v \in \mathbb{N}$ and $m = q^2 + q + 1$. Let $a_0, \dots, a_q$ be integers in $\{1, \dots, m\}$ such that every $r \in \{1, \dots, m - 1\}$ is congruent modulo $m$ to $a_i - a_j$ for exactly one ordered pair $(i, j)$ with $i \ne j$ (a Singer difference set modulo $m$). Let $B$ be a finite set of integers such that every $x \in \{1, \dots, v\}$ equals $b - b'$ for at least $g$ ordered pairs…
nodes.title: Singer product construction of difference bases

nodes.summary: Let $g, n \in \mathbb{N}$ with $n > 1$, and let $\eta_g(n)$ be the least size of a finite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ such that every $x \in \{1, \dots, n\}$ equals $a - a'$ for at least $g$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$. Then $\eta_g(n) / \sqrt{n} \ge \sqrt{2g}$.
nodes.title: Trivial lower bound for difference bases of an interval

nodes.summary: Let $G_1, G_2$ be abelian groups, $g_1, g_2 \in \mathbb{N}$, and $A_1 \subseteq G_1$, $A_2 \subseteq G_2$ finite sets. If every element of $G_1$ equals $a - a'$ for at least $g_1$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A_1 \times A_1$, and every element of $G_2$ equals $a - a'$ for at least $g_2$ ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A_2 \times A_2$, then every element of $G_1 \times G_2$ equals $z - z'$ for at least $g_1 g_2$ ordered…
nodes.title: Products of difference bases

nodes.summary: For every finite subset $A$ of an abelian group, $r_{A-A}(0) = |A|$: the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = 0$ equals the number of elements of $A$.
nodes.title: Representations of zero as a difference

nodes.summary: For a finite subset $A$ of an abelian group $G$ and an element $x \in G$, the difference representation function $r_{A-A}(x)$ is the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$.
nodes.title: Difference representation function

nodes.summary: For a finite set $A$ of integers and an integer $x$, write $r_{A-A}(x)$ for the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$. For every integer $g \ge 1$, let $\alpha_g(n)$ be the largest size of a set $A$ of integers in the interval $[1, n]$ with $r_{A-A}(x) \le g$ for every nonzero integer $x$. Then $\alpha_g(n) / \sqrt{gn} \to 1$ as $n \to \infty$, that is,…
nodes.title: Asymptotics of the largest sets with bounded difference counts

nodes.summary: For a finite set $A$ of integers and an integer $x$, write $r_{A-A}(x)$ for the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$. For every integer $g \ge 1$, let $\eta_g(n)$ be the least size of a finite set $A$ of integers with $r_{A-A}(x) \ge g$ for every integer $x \in [1, n]$. Then there is a real number $c > 0$ with $\eta_g(n) / \sqrt{n} \to c$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Kravitz's question: the normalized difference basis numbers converge

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and $g \ge 1$ an integer. For a finite abelian group $G$, a set $A \subseteq G$ and $x \in G$, write $r_{A-A}(x)$ for the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$, and let $\eta_g(G)$ be the least size of a set $A \subseteq G$ with $r_{A-A}(x) \ge g$ for every $x \in G$. nodes.title: Even and odd limits for difference bases of $\mathbb{F}_p^n$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime. For a finite abelian group $G$, a set $A \subseteq G$ and $x \in G$, write $r_{A-A}(x)$ for the number of ordered pairs $(a, a') \in A \times A$ with $a - a' = x$, and let $\eta_1(G)$ be the least size of a set $A \subseteq G$ with $r_{A-A}(x) \ge 1$ for every $x \in G$. Then $\eta_1(\mathbb{F}_{p^t} \times \mathbb{F}_{p^t}) / p^t \to 1$ as $t \to \infty$, that is,…
nodes.title: Difference bases of $\mathbb{F}_{p^t} \times \mathbb{F}_{p^t}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
